scripts.dev:up: docker compose -f docker/compose.dev.yml up --build --detach --wait --wait-timeout 900 && echo "OpenBot dev is up on http://localhost:${OPENBOT_DEV_PORT:-3000}"
scripts.dev:sh: docker compose -f docker/compose.dev.yml exec --user openbot-server openbot bash
scripts.dev:seed: docker compose -f docker/compose.dev.yml exec --user openbot-server openbot pnpm --filter @openbot/webapp seed
